metadata.description:
With a collection that spans 5,000 years and free admission that invites everyone, Mia is where art history meets community spirit. From ancient Chinese bronzes to contemporary masterworks, every visit is a walk through human creativity. Even the building itself whispers elegance and curiosity. Add this Culture Collector POAP to your set for exploring artistic wonder in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Culture Collector 
GPS: 44.9583, -93.27316
